Game Overview

Tung Tung Sahur Supermarket is a simulation title where join Tung Tung Sahur in a quirky supermarket adventure. Manage the bustling store by scanning items quickly, ensuring spotless aisles, and restocking shelves. Balance speed and efficiency to keep quirky shoppers happy and the store thriving. Can you handle the rush without breaking a sweat?
